gate: Underneath this code runs the felt knowing that spirit is the actual source of supply, not the bank account, not the praise, not the food on the table. A person carrying this gate moves through life on a slow weather pattern. The mood swings up into a fullness that feels like the world is feeding them straight from source, then it swings down into a hollow where nothing tastes of anything and the carrier is sure something is wrong with them. The wave is the code, not a malfunction inside it. The hollow is not depression to be cured, it is the trough of the same wave whose crest was joy a week earlier. Most people mistake this rhythm for moodiness or instability. The carrier often mistakes it for that too, and tries to flatten the wave into something more presentable. Flattened, the code loses its information. Ridden, it teaches that abundance is felt, not held.
centre_field: Down on the lower right of the body-map sits a triangle that does two jobs at once, pumping feeling out as a motor and reading feeling in as an awareness. That double nature is the teaching. The wave here is not a reaction to events, it is the centre's native motion, on and off across days, the way breath goes in and out across seconds. When the centre is up, the code reads as fullness, generosity, a sense that life is plenty. When it is down, the same body reads scarcity, dryness, a quiet conviction that the well has gone empty. Nothing in the world has actually changed. The centre has moved through its own arc. Carrying this gate means living inside that arc and learning that clarity comes at the end of the wave, not in the middle of one of its swings.
channel: One end of a wire lives in this code, and the wire runs down through the body-map toward the gate of provocation at the adrenal floor. Together the two form the channel of emoting, a current that carries feeling out as something a room can actually catch. The reach matters. Spirit, on its own, is a private weather. The carrier feels the abundance and the hollow, the fullness and the dryness, with no built-in way to make any of it useful to another person. Without the provocation, the wave just rolls through one body and out again, beautiful and unread. The poke is what gives the wave a target, a stuck place to land on, a ribcage to press. Joined, mood becomes message. The fullness pokes others awake to spirit, and the hollow pokes them awake to what they have been pretending about supply. Alone, this code is a weather system passing over an empty field.
